resources.string: Pause fully while an excluded app is in front
While an excluded app is the main window, processing and capture both stop. They come back when you switch to another app.
This needs usage access to know which app is the main window. Turning it on grants it at once when Shizuku is connected, or opens the settings page.
Which app does it go by?

It goes by the app in the main window.

• YouTube (excluded) in the main window: paused. Spotify or YouTube Music playing behind it then also plays unprocessed, as it is.
• YouTube in picture-in-picture or a floating window, another app in the main window: not paused. The music keeps being processed; YouTube's own sound is excluded and plays as it is.
• Split screen: the app opened last counts as the main window, because which window has focus cannot be known.
• Screen off: not paused.

Why: this app captures other apps' sound and processes it, and the capture happens before each app's own volume. So a video an app mutes in-app (Instagram, YouTube) can be heard through Rootnote. Excluding that app already lets its sound play as it is and keeps its in-app mute. This option stops Rootnote as a whole while you use that app, so other apps play unprocessed too.

Limits: app switches are checked once a second, so pausing and resuming take up to 1-2 seconds; the sound may cut out or overlap briefly meanwhile.
